subject.title: Bug: Telegram / Feishu / WeCom channels in Docker image 2026.6.10 do not expose multi-account configuration as documented

question: Should maintainers first require one current-release reproduction that separates Telegram/Feishu core setup from the external WeCom plugin and from the thread-reply symptom?
rationale: The current documented contract supports account-aware setup, while the report combines three independently owned surfaces and does not show the current Docker or plugin behavior needed to assign a safe fix owner.

options.title: Request scoped current reproduction
options.body: Ask for redacted v2026.7.1 Docker transcripts/config output per channel and the installed WeCom plugin version before assigning code work.

options.title: Adopt only a confirmed core defect
options.body: If Telegram or Feishu still omit the documented account path on current Docker, track that narrow core regression separately and route WeCom to its plugin owner.

options.title: Treat as historical release behavior
options.body: If the reporter confirms current Docker exposes the account path, close this report as resolved by the newer release and retain any distinct thread issue separately.

recommendation.title: Request scoped current reproduction
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted v2026.7.1 Docker transcripts/config output per channel and the installed WeCom plugin version before assigning code work.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent channel-add work and the current stable release provenance make vincentkoc the closest available routing candidate for a core setup-surface decision.
